agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 annual report, the Board of Commissioners' oversight report, and the consolidated financial statements audited by Purwanto, Sungkoro & Surja (Ernst & Young). The resolution includes granting a full release and discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their management and supervision during the 2025 financial year.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved allocating Rp1,255,580,099,173 in net profit, with Rp1 billion set aside for mandatory reserves and the remainder as retained earnings. No cash dividends will be distributed to maintain the company's liquidity and working capital.
Agenda #3: Shareholders granted the Board of Commissioners the authority to appoint a public accountant to audit the 2026 financial statements and determine the associated honorarium. The selection will consider recommendations from the Audit Committee and comply with prevailing regulations.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners is authorized to set the 2026 salaries and allowances for the Board of Directors. Remuneration for the Board of Commissioners is capped at a maximum of 105% of the previous year's honorarium.
